name: Airwaves
author: Serge Belov
description: Control OwnTone from the bar: now playing, transport, AirPlay and local speaker routing, and a radio station list.

barWidget.description: OwnTone now-playing with transport, speaker routing and radio stations

schema.label: OwnTone API base URL
schema.description: Where OwnTone's REST API lives. Change the host if OwnTone runs on another machine.

schema.label: Stations playlist name
schema.description: Name of the OwnTone playlist holding your radio streams. Resolved by name, so the playlist id does not matter.

schema.label: Stations .m3u file
schema.description: The file backing that playlist, written when you add or remove a station. Defaults to ~/Music/radio.m3u.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the popup re-reads speakers, stations and playback state while open.
